description.value: Cedar Cafe at CMTN is a weekday campus cafe serving Coast Mountain College in Terrace, BC, catering primarily to students and staff. Located on a post-secondary college campus, it offers a coffee shop experience in a busy educational setting. Touring cyclists passing through Terrace on Highway 16 may find it a convenient stop during college operating hours.
